meta.title: Shawn Chang — Product & UX Designer
meta.description: Portfolio of Shawn Chang: product design, UX research and service design. M.A. student at National Tsing Hua University, innovation intern at Logitech.

intro.body: I'm Shawn Chang, an M.A. design student at National Tsing Hua University and an innovation intern at Logitech, focused on product design, UX research and service design.

quotes: Good design starts with **defining the right problem**.
Turn insights into **prototypes fast**, then let users tell us the answer.
Design only ships when it balances **user value and business value**.

about.heading: Turning user needs into products through research insight and rapid prototyping.
paragraphs: I'm Shawn Chang, an M.A. student in Arts and Design at National Tsing Hua University, focusing on product design, UX research and service design. I combine design thinking with business thinking, work comfortably with both qualitative and quantitative methods, and have published four conference papers.

As an innovation intern at Logitech, I ran the company's global hackathon and helped the team turn scattered ideas into a searchable innovation database, bringing in NotebookLM so colleagues could explore and converge concepts in natural language. Two of the ideas were selected by leadership for NPI.
I'm also a member of NTU's Data Analytics & Decision Club and Management Consulting Club, which trained me to define problems precisely and make data-driven decisions.

experience.description: Co-defined the annual innovation challenges with department heads and ran 4 innovation programs (Mei-Chu Hackathon, MakeNTU, Logi Hackathon, Epoch Garage+) on time within a NT$1.2M budget, drawing 50+ teams and 300+ participants and producing 100+ concepts and PoC prototypes. Two hardware concepts (mouse, keyboard) advanced into NPI. Built a department portal with a NotebookLM innovation knowledge base and led 3+ Future Design workshops.

experience.org: Taiwan Design Research Institute · Strategic Foresight R&D
experience.description: Reviewed 30+ papers on smart healthcare and design technology across 10 foresight topics, organized an expert panel and analyzed interviews, and synthesized foresight trends and international market opportunities.

Cleaned 100,000+ PC sales records and built Power BI dashboards showing MoM and QoQ performance across OEM and channel SKUs, used by sales and account managers to set second-half budgets; co-marketed Windows 11 and Microsoft 365 with Intel and resellers at 2 roadshows and a launch event (110+ attendees).

Supported three NSTC projects on AIGC in design workflows, kansei and usability of physical vs. virtual interfaces, and home dialysis self-care. Led study design, data collection and analysis (Excel, SPSS).

clubs.name: NTU Consulting Club
clubs.description: Trained in consulting thinking: defining problems precisely, breaking them down and communicating in a structured way.

clubs.name: NTU Data Analytics Club
